title: Breadcrumb
description: A trail in a navigation landmark, built with Breadcrumb, BreadcrumbLink, and BreadcrumbCurrent, with the separator prop on each step after the first and a house icon in a BreadcrumbSlot as its first step. The icon step takes its name from aria-label and a hover surface from $hoverOffset, and the steps wrap when they run out of room. Use it as the baseline for a page in a hierarchy, before adding other separators, truncation, or menus.
